issue.message: This library supports using KSP instead of kapt, which greatly improves performance. Learn more: https://developer.android.com/studio/build/migrate-to-ksp
issue.summary: Kapt usage should be replaced with KSP
issue.explanation: KSP is a more efficient replacement for kapt. For libraries that support both, KSP should be used to improve build times.

issue.message: Should explicitly set `android:icon`, there is no default
issue.explanation: You should set an icon for the application as whole because there is no default. This attribute must be set as a reference to a drawable resource containing the image (for example `@drawable/icon`).
